optimization.assumptions: Divisible aggregate loads. Same-day moves only; HVAC ≤1h, industry ≤2h, EV ≤6h within 00–07 / 07–17 / 17–24 connection sessions, pumps ≤8h. Operating windows and feeder caps enforced. Hospitals fixed. This is not a unit-level machine scheduling or AC power-flow solver.

weather.generation_kind: Engineering estimate; no measured generation is available.
weather.temporal_method: Hourly weather held constant across its four 15-minute slots.
weather.assumptions: PV: GHI proxy, 0.86 performance ratio, -0.4%/°C cell-temperature coefficient. Wind: 80m hub, 0.14 shear exponent, 3/12/25 m/s cut-in/rated/cut-out.

provenance.title: Individual Household Electric Power Consumption
provenance.location: One household in Sceaux, France; NOT measured Pune city demand
provenance.processing: 15-minute mean of available measurements; empty bins forward-filled causally. Any target window with incomplete bins is excluded from evaluation. No city measurements are claimed.

assumptions: City demand is simulated: 800-household equivalent plus modeled commercial/industrial/EV/HVAC/pump/hospital loads.
UCI source is a single French household from 2009–2010, not live Pune consumption. Forecasts transfer its shape to the scenario timeline.
Solar/wind are weather-derived estimates. Grid imports are simulated, capped dispatchable supply. No battery is modeled.
Forecast validation is on original household kW, not city MW. City forecasts have no measured accuracy claim.
Demo tariff: ₹5/kWh off-peak, ₹8 08–17h, ₹12 17–22h. Savings use served grid-import energy; compare unserved energy too.
Isolation Forest alerts are household-model demonstrations applied to equivalent loads, not a validated city fault diagnosis.
No AC/DC network flows, voltage, line losses, contingencies, billing demand charges, or real-time hardware control.
